clips.title: The story
paras: Verdan the Everliving is a colossal bog beast lurking deep within the verdant tunnels of the Wailing Caverns. Once a peaceful protector of the underground springs and flora, he was twisted by the waking nightmare radiating from the sleeping druid Naralex. Now bound to the corrupted Druids of the Fang, Verdan violently attacks any who venture into his damp hollows.

Long before Naralex arrived to tap into the natural springs of the Barrens, Verdan was formed from the overgrown foliage, silt, and moisture filling the caves. Thought to be the original guardian spirit of the subterranean oasis, Verdan was an ancient, gentle elemental keeping watch over the underground flora.
